title: feat(core): isCloudManaged() is the one reader of OS_CLOUD_MANAGED, with the production fuse at first read and at kernel boot
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgX3AnP5C73ugJYnWGR6GGcn)_

Fixes #25294
Part of #25083 (the engine half, item 1; the services half in plugin-auth stays open on #25083).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this lands

The engine half of ruling 6341690661 on #25083, **Q2 → D**: `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` is the managed-mode switch on every boot, read by one accessor in `@objectstack/core` beside `isHostKernelComposition`, with the production fuse.

### The exports (`@objectstack/core`, `packages/core/src/stack-auth.ts`; names are final)

- **`isCloudManaged(): boolean`** is synchronous and has no arguments. It returns `true` when `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` is exactly `1` and `false` when the variable is unset or empty. Any other value (`true`, `0`, `yes`) throws an error naming the value. The answer is memoized for the process, and a refusal is memoized too: every later read throws the same error.
- **`resetCloudManagedForTesting(): void`** forgets the memo, so the next read decides again from `process.env`. It is for tests only, and no boot calls it. Usage in a test: set `process.env.OS_CLOUD_MANAGED = '1'`, then call `resetCloudManagedForTesting()`. At the end, delete the variable and call `resetCloudManagedForTesting()` again. Under vitest `NODE_ENV` is `test`, so the fuse does not fire and the variable alone reads managed.
- **`resolveControlPlaneApiKey(configured?: string): string`** returns the configured value if one is given, else `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`, trimmed, or an empty string when neither is set. It is the one derivation of "a control plane is bound".

### The fuse

A production boot that finds `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` and `resolveControlPlaneApiKey() === ''` refuses. Production means not a development boot and not `NODE_ENV=test`. The development check reuses the existing reading, `isDevelopmentBoot()` (`stack-auth.ts`); `os serve --dev` sets `NODE_ENV=development` before anything is imported — only when `NODE_ENV` is unset, so `NODE_ENV=production os serve --dev` reads as a production boot and is refused the same way. The refusal message names `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED`, the missing `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`, and both remedies. It fires:

- at `isCloudManaged()`'s first read, and
- at the top of `ObjectKernel.bootstrap()` and `LiteKernel.bootstrap()`, before any plugin's `init()`. Every kernel in the process reads the same memoized fact, including per-environment kernels that carry no reader. ⛔ It is not in `serve.ts`.

### One source for "control plane bound"

cloud-connection depends on core, so core cannot read cloud-connection's `platformManaged`. The derivation therefore moves into core. `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts` `start()` now computes `cloudApiKey` as `resolveControlPlaneApiKey(this.cfg.controlPlaneApiKey)`, which is the same precedence and trim as the inline expression it replaces. The seat widened the claim's file surface to that line in claim amendment 6352016263. The cross-lane declaration on the `domain:cli` seat post is comment 6352046857 on #6024. The diff touches two lines there: the import and the derivation.

**The known cost (accepted by the seat):** a process-wide accessor cannot see any plugin's options, so the fuse reads only the environment arm. A production runtime that binds its control plane only through `CloudConnectionPlugin`'s `controlPlaneApiKey` option and also sets `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` is refused, and the remedy is to set `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`. This is the loud, safe direction. In this repository, no production construction passes `controlPlaneApiKey`. cloud-connection documents `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY` as "injected by the cloud into the runtimes it hosts". The cloud repository is private and was not read.

### Measured before the edit (origin/main `fb7501bc6`)

- Current readers of `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED`: **0**. `git grep -n OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` has no hits outside changelogs, so nothing was folded onto the accessor. After this PR, `decideCloudManaged()` in `stack-auth.ts` is the only reader.
- `platformManaged` was derived inline at `cloud-connection-plugin.ts:316/335`.
- `--dev` is read once, by `isDevelopmentBoot()`.

## Tests (`packages/core/src/cloud-managed.test.ts`, head `569f28a5c`)

- Pin 9, one case each: a `--dev` boot (`NODE_ENV=development`) with the variable runs managed; a production boot with the variable and `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY` runs managed; a production boot with the variable and no key refuses, and the test asserts the message's first sentence; without the variable nothing is managed.
- Edges: `NODE_ENV=test` with the variable runs managed. An unset `NODE_ENV` counts as production. A blank key is no binding. An empty variable is off, and other values are refused. The memo holds, including a refusal, until reset. `resolveControlPlaneApiKey` precedence is pinned.
- Kernel boot: for `ObjectKernel` and for `LiteKernel`, `bootstrap()` rejects before the probe plugin's `init()` runs, and boots once a key is set.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`: 111 files, 2649 tests passed. `typecheck` passed (tsc, examples, check:test-typecheck).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: 54 files, 670 tests passed. `typecheck` passed.

**Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which restores the file and verifies its blob equals HEAD):
- Fuse removed (`if (false && production && …)`): 5 failed and 6 passed. The refusal pin and the four other refusal cases (unset `NODE_ENV`, memo, both kernels) go red. The three pin-9 run cases stay green.
- `ObjectKernel.bootstrap()`'s call removed: only the ObjectKernel boot pin goes red (1 failed, 10 passed). The same holds for `LiteKernel`.

## Gates

`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 69 families on this diff. All 69 were run locally on `569f28a5c`, and `--ran` reconciles them: 68 run, 1 NOT MEASURED.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs the whole workspace built). It is left to CI.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone. After `git fetch` of the fixture commit it was re-run and exited 0. The record carries the re-run.
- The other 66 exited 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` keeps the maintainer's name: no `_ENABLED` suffix, the recorded exception to Prime Directive 9 (ruling 6341690661).
- The strict value check (only `1` turns it on; other non-empty values are refused on every boot) is this PR's reading of the ruling's "`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1` is the switch". It is there so a mistyped switch cannot run a hosted runtime unmanaged. The reviewer may narrow it to the ruling's literal reading.
- Not in scope: plugin-auth and every judgement site (the services half of #25083), `serve.ts`, the platform-objects predicates (#25295), and the spec features registry (#25292).
